Convention of this benchmark (not law): Study 4 SPEC.md item 6a

convention.text: A fact that the file does not mention is taken as not alleged, and the rules are applied as if it were absent. Silence never ends a process: where a fact's absence would end it, the unmentioned fact is unresolved. The defining event is never presumed: if the file does not mention it, it is unresolved. A fact that the file raises and leaves unsettled is open.
convention.applies_to: every fact of every type except the defining event, a fact whose value false triggers a stop, and a fact marked always_stated; a statutory presumption under the type's presumptions takes precedence

translation_notes.en: The claim prescribes if not brought before the courts
translation_notes.de: eine Klage anhängig gemacht ... ist der Anspruch verwirkt
translation_notes.followed: forfeited ("verwirkt"), which applies by itself, not "prescribes" (a time bar that must be pleaded); the claim must be made pending ("anhängig gemacht"), which under CPC art. 62 para. 1 happens when a conciliation request or an action is filed, read with CPC art. 62 para. 1 (an inference across the two acts: the CO says "anhängig gemacht", the CPC defines "Rechtshängigkeit"), not only "brought before the courts"

translation_notes.en: the employer cannot cite just cause
translation_notes.de: der Arbeitgeber nicht beweisen kann, dass er einen begründeten Anlass zur Kündigung hatte
translation_notes.followed: the employer must prove a justified reason ("begründeter Anlass"), a lower standard than the good cause ("wichtiger Grund") of art. 337
abusive ("missbräuchlich"): the notice stays effective and gives rise to compensation (arts. 336a, 336b), it is not void

translation_notes.en: submit his objection ... in writing to the party giving such notice
translation_notes.followed: the objection is lodged with the employer, not merely sent

types.title: Notice of termination by the employer during a protected period (CO art. 336c)

facts.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?
facts.not_this: A resignation by the employee, a fixed-term relationship that ended by running out, or a dismissal with immediate effect (art. 337, a separate type).

rule.passage: After the probation period has expired, the employer may not terminate the employment relationship

passage_de.passage: Nach Ablauf der Probezeit darf der Arbeitgeber das Arbeitsverhältnis nicht kündigen

facts.question: Was the notice given while the probation period was still running, counting any extension of the probation period under art. 335b para. 3 (a probation period interrupted by illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation is extended accordingly)?
facts.not_this: Notice given after the probation period, with any such extension, had expired.

rule.passage: After the probation period has expired, the employer may not terminate the employment relationship

passage_de.passage: Nach Ablauf der Probezeit darf der Arbeitgeber das Arbeitsverhältnis nicht kündigen

rule.inference: The bar applies only after the probation period has expired, so notice given during it is outside the bar; art. 335b para. 3 says how long the probation period runs when it is interrupted.

also.passage: Where the period that would normally constitute the probation period is interrupted by illness, accident or performance of a non-voluntary legal obligation, the probation period is extended accordingly.

passage_de.passage: Bei einer effektiven Verkürzung der Probezeit infolge Krankheit, Unfall oder Erfüllung einer nicht freiwillig übernommenen gesetzlichen Pflicht erfolgt eine entsprechende Verlängerung der Probezeit.

facts.question: Does the file say that a written individual agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract set a probation period other than the first month of employment?
facts.not_this: An oral arrangement about probation, or a remark only that the employee was still new.

rule.passage: Different terms may be envisaged by an individual written agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract; however, the probation period may not exceed three months.

passage_de.passage: Durch schriftliche Abrede, Normalarbeitsvertrag oder Gesamtarbeitsvertrag können abweichende Vereinbarungen getroffen werden; die Probezeit darf jedoch auf höchstens drei Monate verlängert werden.

facts.question: Was the employee, through no fault of their own, wholly or partly prevented from working by illness or accident on the day notice was given or at some time while the notice period was running, and was the incapacity at that point still within its protected length: up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years, 180 days from the sixth year?
facts.not_this: Incapacity the employee caused through their own fault; days of incapacity beyond the 30, 90 or 180 days; incapacity that ended before notice was given or began only after the notice period had ended.

rule.locator: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. b; para. 2
rule.passage: while the employee through no fault of his own is partially or entirely prevented from working by illness or accident for up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years of service and 180 days in the sixth and subsequent years of service

passage_de.passage: während der Arbeitnehmer ohne eigenes Verschulden durch Krankheit oder durch Unfall ganz oder teilweise an der Arbeitsleistung verhindert ist, und zwar im ersten Dienstjahr während 30 Tagen, ab zweitem bis und mit fünftem Dienstjahr während 90 Tagen und ab sechstem Dienstjahr während 180 Tagen

also.passage: where such notice was given prior to the commencement of a proscribed period but the notice period has not yet expired at that juncture, it is suspended and does not resume until the proscribed period has ended

facts.question: Was the employee performing Swiss compulsory military service, civil defence service or alternative civilian service on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running, or, for such a service lasting more than eleven days, did either of those fall within the four weeks before or after it?
facts.not_this: Voluntary service, service in a foreign army, a service of eleven days or less that did not overlap the notice day or the notice period, or an overseas aid project (art. 336c para. 1 let. d, not covered here).

rule.locator: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. a; para. 2
rule.passage: while the other party is performing Swiss compulsory military or civil defence service or Swiss alternative civilian service or, where such service lasts for more than eleven days, during the four weeks preceding or following it

passage_de.passage: während die andere Partei schweizerischen obligatorischen Militär- oder Schutzdienst oder schweizerischen Zivildienst leistet, sowie, sofern die Dienstleistung mehr als elf Tage dauert, während vier Wochen vorher und nachher

also.passage: where such notice was given prior to the commencement of a proscribed period but the notice period has not yet expired at that juncture, it is suspended and does not resume until the proscribed period has ended

passage_de.passage: ist dagegen die Kündigung vor Beginn einer solchen Frist erfolgt, aber die Kündigungsfrist bis dahin noch nicht abgelaufen, so wird deren Ablauf unterbrochen und erst nach Beendigung der Sperrfrist fortgesetzt

facts.question: Was the employee pregnant, or within sixteen weeks after giving birth, on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running?
facts.not_this: Pregnancy of the employee's partner; the further leave periods of art. 336c para. 1 let. cbis to cquinquies, which this rule set does not cover.

rule.locator: CO art. 336c para. 1 let. c; para. 2
rule.passage: during the pregnancy of an employee and the sixteen weeks following birth

passage_de.passage: während der Schwangerschaft und in den 16 Wochen nach der Niederkunft einer Arbeitnehmerin

also.passage: where such notice was given prior to the commencement of a proscribed period but the notice period has not yet expired at that juncture, it is suspended and does not resume until the proscribed period has ended

facts.question: Where a protected period (illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, as above) is raised: was the notice given before that period began, with the notice period not yet expired when it began?
facts.not_this: Notice given on a day that already fell inside the protected period (that notice is void, not suspended). Not asked where no protected period is raised.

rule.passage: where such notice was given prior to the commencement of a proscribed period but the notice period has not yet expired at that juncture, it is suspended and does not resume until the proscribed period has ended

passage_de.passage: ist dagegen die Kündigung vor Beginn einer solchen Frist erfolgt, aber die Kündigungsfrist bis dahin noch nicht abgelaufen, so wird deren Ablauf unterbrochen und erst nach Beendigung der Sperrfrist fortgesetzt

facts.question: Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?
facts.not_this: A notice period that only the termination letter states, with no written contract term behind it.

rule.passage: These notice periods may be varied by written individual, standard or collective employment contract

passage_de.passage: Diese Fristen dürfen durch schriftliche Abrede, Normalarbeitsvertrag oder Gesamtarbeitsvertrag abgeändert werden

types.title: Wrongful (abusive) notice of termination by the employer: objection and compensation claim (CO arts. 336-336b)

facts.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?
facts.not_this: A resignation by the employee, a fixed-term relationship that ended by running out, or a dismissal with immediate effect (art. 337, a separate type).

rule.passage: the party on whom notice was served may bring his claim for compensation

passage_de.passage: so kann die Partei, der gekündigt worden ist, ihren Anspruch auf Entschädigung geltend machen

rule.inference: The claim belongs to the party on whom notice was served; in this employee-side regime that is the employee, so the notice is the employer's.

facts.question: Has the notice period (from the notice to the end of the employment relationship) already ended?
facts.not_this: The employee's last working day where they were released from work while the notice period was still running; the end date stated in the notice where a protected period has suspended the notice period (art. 336c para. 2) or untaken leave of the other parent has extended it (art. 335c para. 3): the period then ends later, and if the file raises either, the fact is open.

rule.passage: A party seeking compensation pursuant to Articles 336 and 336a must submit his objection to the notice of termination in writing to the party giving such notice not later than the end of the notice period.

passage_de.passage: Wer gestützt auf Artikel 336 und 336a eine Entschädigung geltend machen will, muss gegen die Kündigung längstens bis zum Ende der Kündigungsfrist beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben.

facts.question: Did the employee lodge a written objection to the notice with the employer (German: "beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben") no later than the end of the notice period?
facts.not_this: An oral protest; an objection addressed to someone other than the employer; a written objection lodged only after the notice period had ended.

rule.passage: A party seeking compensation pursuant to Articles 336 and 336a must submit his objection to the notice of termination in writing to the party giving such notice not later than the end of the notice period.

passage_de.passage: Wer gestützt auf Artikel 336 und 336a eine Entschädigung geltend machen will, muss gegen die Kündigung längstens bis zum Ende der Kündigungsfrist beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben.

facts.question: Did the employee and the employer agree, after the notice, that the employment relationship would continue?
facts.not_this: Talks about continuing that ended without agreement; an agreement only about a payment or about the end date.

rule.passage: Where the objection has been properly submitted and the parties cannot reach agreement on the continuation of the employment relationship, the party on whom notice was served may bring his claim for compensation.

passage_de.passage: Ist die Einsprache gültig erfolgt und einigen sich die Parteien nicht über die Fortsetzung des Arbeitsverhältnisses, so kann die Partei, der gekündigt worden ist, ihren Anspruch auf Entschädigung geltend machen.

facts.question: Have more than 180 days passed since the employment relationship ended?
facts.not_this: 180 days counted from the notice or from the last day actually worked rather than from the end of the employment relationship; an end date that a protected period (art. 336c para. 2) or untaken leave of the other parent (art. 335c para. 3) has moved later: if the file raises either, the fact is open.

rule.passage: The claim prescribes if not brought before the courts within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship.

passage_de.passage: Wird nicht innert 180 Tagen nach Beendigung des Arbeitsverhältnisses eine Klage anhängig gemacht, ist der Anspruch verwirkt.

facts.question: Did the employee make the compensation claim pending (German: "Klage anhängig gemacht") within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship?
facts.not_this: A demand letter to the employer; a claim made pending only after the 180 days.

rule.passage: The claim prescribes if not brought before the courts within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship.

passage_de.passage: Wird nicht innert 180 Tagen nach Beendigung des Arbeitsverhältnisses eine Klage anhängig gemacht, ist der Anspruch verwirkt.

facts.question: Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the notice in writing?
facts.not_this: Reasons the employer gave without being asked, or a request made only orally to a colleague rather than to the employer.

rule.passage: The party giving notice of termination must state his reasons in writing if the other party so requests.

passage_de.passage: Der Kündigende muss die Kündigung schriftlich begründen, wenn die andere Partei dies verlangt.

facts.question: Was the notice given because the employee had asserted, in good faith, claims arising from the employment relationship?
facts.not_this: Complaints that are not claims under the employment relationship, or a mere coincidence in time with no link to the notice.

rule.passage: because the other party asserts claims under the employment relationship in good faith

passage_de.passage: weil die andere Partei nach Treu und Glauben Ansprüche aus dem Arbeitsverhältnis geltend macht

facts.question: Was the employee, when notice was given, an elected employee representative on the staff council of the business or on a body linked to the business?
facts.not_this: Trade-union membership or union activity without an elected mandate (art. 336 para. 2 let. a, not covered here); a representative whose mandate ended through a transfer of the employment relationship, whose protection continues (art. 336 para. 3, not covered here).

rule.passage: while the employee is an elected employee representative on the staff council for the business or on a body linked to the business and the employer cannot cite just cause to terminate his employment

facts.question: Did the employer end the employment relationship with immediate effect, without a notice period?
